description: Known-bad dossiers the adapter must reject, and one it must accept. Registered so `adversarial: true` in the manifest is a test rather than a self-report.

reject.why: a source derives from something written later
every origin has the same stake
three language hops, no original wording quoted
occurrence, motive, and typicality from two documents
an absence claim with no survival argument
no statement of what falsity would look like
two declared origins whose readings share two errors — one voice counted as two

accept.why: two genuinely distinct origins, chains in order, bounds stated
